222-527-7272-8296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.

Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.

751-4068-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
751-4068-4289.description:

Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1680-4881-6909-8199.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{W} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
1680-4881-6909-8199.easyPrerequisites: Runed Stalactite is attached to Carnage.
1680-4881-6909-8199.description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-4215-6730.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
3899-4215-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

862-2459-4973-6516.easyPrerequisites:

Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

997-2946-4871-6112.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
997-2946-4871-6112.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-647-3291.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-647-3291.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.

4116-4929-5636-5660.easyPrerequisites: There are at least four permanent cards between your hand and graveyard.
4116-4929-5636-5660.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four cards in hand.
4116-4929-5636-5660.description:

Holding priority, activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Evolution Witness until your next turn.
Resolve the first Volrath ability from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Volrath triggers, returning a permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for each remaining ability.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Cryptic Trilobite until end of turn.
Activate Volrath using Cryptic Trilobite's ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

3165-3532-5078-7444.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.

Repeat.

Berta and Animation Module trigger.

When the Treasure enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

341-2034-4871-5497-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.

Holding priority, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.

4681-5170-5686-6634.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.

Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5413-6529.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5413-6529.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.

Callous Sell-Sword enters the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it for each creature you controlled that died this turn.

Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.

When Island Fish Jasconius's controller controls no Islands, Island Fish Jasconius triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Island Fish Jasconius cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Island Fish Jasconius triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

Sacrifice the Treasure token for {G}.

Repeat.

When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
